Prevention: Knowledge of history about the prevalence of the pest
Practice crop rotation e.g. plant groundnuts after maize.
Avoid growing crops of the same family (e.g. rice, millet)
Remove all crop residues and burn or bury away from the maize field
Monitoring: Regular visits to farm to identify the presence/absence of the pest
Look for eggs at the axis of the leaves
Look for possible symptoms, e.g. brown/black tunnels on stems
Check level of attack on crop for severity of destruction/ damage
Direct Control: Identify eggs on the leaves and destroy by removing infested leaves and safely dispose either by burning or burying.
Use of sharp instrument to prick the larvae in the tunnel(s).
Remove all affected crops and burn or bury away from the maize field
Restrictions: II); Do not use during flowering period to avoid killing pollinators (e.g. bees)
